C0232.title: Man Sentenced for Selling Access to Pornographic App Accounts, Earning 20,000 Yuan Illegally
C0232.summary: In April 2023, a man was convicted of illegally using information networks for sharing access to pornographic app accounts with others for a fee, making an illicit profit of 20,000 yuan. The court ruled the act constituted a typical case of unauthorized account sharing and reselling paid access for profit.
